The test image shows coffee berries on a branch with significant dark discoloration - many berries are turning dark purple/black, some appear shriveled/mummified. The leaves also show small brown spots in the background. This is clearly a berry-affecting disease.

Top candidates: **Berry_Blotch** (dark berry discoloration is the hallmark), possibly Phoma.

Now viewing one reference image from Berry_Blotch to confirm.

The Berry_Blotch reference shows leaves with brown blotch spots and small darkened berries/fruits visible, consistent with berry-affecting disease. The test image shows the same pattern at a more advanced stage - coffee berries with extensive dark/black discoloration and shriveling across the branch.

The match is clear: test image shows characteristic berry darkening/blackening (not leaf disease), which aligns with Berry_Blotch. The other classes (Rust, Brown_Eye_Spot, Cercospora, Miner) primarily manifest on leaves, not berries.
